title: Priority warm-handoff protocol for regional elective degradation — communication, hotpatch validation, and customer traffic safeguarding
text:
Priority warm-handoff protocol for regional elective degradation — communication, hotpatch validation, and customer traffic safeguarding

description:
Context: Following a series of partial region degradations last quarter, customers experienced elevated tail latency and increased errors when traffic was progressively shifted to standby regions. This ticket creates a tested, customer-facing warm-handoff protocol for elective degradation scenarios (not full region failover) to minimize request loss, KV cache thrash, and support load spikes on Dedicated fleets. Goals: (1) define a low-risk traffic handoff sequence for hosted and dedicated tenants, (2) embed customer communications and escalation templates, (3) add a validated hotpatch playbook for an on-path kernel bug that manifests under cross-region rehome, (4) add observability checkpoints and rollback criteria, (5) automate prefill/priming of KV cache for hotspot tenants during handoff. Success criteria: runbook executed in staging with <1% 5xx increase during synthetic traffic shift, automated prefill reduces cold-kv miss rate by >=70%, customer communication template approved by product and support, hotpatch rollout completed and validated in canary cluster, runbook merged and published in Confluence.

acceptance_criteria:
Documented warm-handoff runbook with step-by-step operator commands and estimated time-to-stable
Automated prefill job that can target tenant slices and report prefill completion metric (prefill_completion_ratio)
Hotpatch pipeline for kernel fix with canary -> ramp -> global steps and clear rollback commands
Customer communication templates for initial notification, live update, and resolution with suggested Slack/email text
End-to-end tabletop executed with SRE/Support/PM/Eng and feedback incorporated

runbook_summary:
High-level sequence: (1) notify affected customers via template and open incident channel; (2) place tenant slice on protective rate-limit and circuit-breaker; (3) schedule prefill jobs to populate KV caches in target region; (4) spin up standby pods and confirm readiness probes; (5) perform incremental redispatch at 5% increments with 2-minute stabilization windows and automated health checks; (6) if error rate or latency breach thresholds hit, execute single-command rollback and notify customers; (7) run post-handoff reconciliation (KV merge, metrics retention).

hotpatch_playbook:
When memory allocation bug appears under cross-region rehome: (a) build patched runtime binary with feature-flagguarded path; (b) deploy to canary nodes limited to 5% tenant traffic; (c) run synthetic churn and KV hotkey tests for 30 minutes; (d) if pass, ramp to 25% then 100% with automated success gates; (e) failure path: toggle flag off and run rollback binary; (f) open PR with test artifacts and link to incident context.

observability_checkpoints:
prefill_completion_ratio per tenant slice
5xx_rate aggregated and by tenant during shift
median and 99th latency pre/during/post shift
kv_miss_rate and cache_fill_latency
active_pending_requests and queue_depth per region

next_steps:
Instrument prefill API to accept tenant slice and ttl hints (owner: @eng-kv-team, ETA: 2025-02-18)
Build hotpatch pipeline PR and run in canary cluster (owner: @runtime-team, PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pulls/4621)
Schedule tabletop with SRE, Support, PM, and legal to rehearse public comms (owner: Priya, date: 2025-02-17)
Add observability checkpoints to Console: pre-shift baseline, mid-shift health, post-shift reconciliation (owner: console-observability)
Create automated rollback playbook that can be triggered with a single tag and documented time-to-recover estimate

postmortem_todo:
Capture timeline and annotate decisions in incident doc
Measure customer-visible impact and reconcile billing adjustments for affected Dedicated customers
Author technical writeup for kernel bug root cause and long-term fix
Add runbook to on-call rotation checklist and train SREs
Propose proactive prefill for top-50 tenants during planned maintenance
